Description

New TinySat picosatellite format,

The StratoSat-TK1-B spacecraft (developed with the participation of the Bauman Engineering School 1580), StratoSat-TK1-V, StratoSat-TK1-G, are made in the TynySat 1TU format and are cube-shaped pico-satellites with a side size of 5 cm. Designed for flight qualification of the TinySat pico-satellite platform, developed by Small Space Systems LLC. As a payload they have a camera with a resolution of 0.3 - 2 MP. The main mission is to confirm the performance of the delivery method using the mother CubeSat “StratoSat-TK1” and conduct educational events on working with satellites for schoolchildren and students.

The payload of the StratoSat-TK1 spacecraft was developed with the participation of Stratonavtika LLC, Moscow, Small Space Systems LLC Moscow, MT FINANCE LLC (RUVDS trademark), Moscow, Impulse Team - Palace of Pioneers and schoolchildren named after N.K. Krupskaya, Chelyabinsk, GBOU "Bauman Engineering School 1580".

Spacecraft are managed by Stratonavtika LLC and Geoscan LLC using their own space communication stations and stations of partner organizations.
